title: Committed docs expose developer's absolute filesystem paths (/Users/moses/...)
detail: Machine-local absolute paths (username, directory layout) are committed to repo docs — minor info disclosure and dead references for any other clone.
recommended_fix: Use repo-relative or workspace-relative paths (e.g. `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/...`) in silhouette-spec.md §Sources and §2, and assets/blender/README.md.

title: .blend commit policy lacks a Blender auto-run caveat (embedded-script execution vector)
evidence:
The `.blend` files ARE committed — they are the reproducible source of the
committed PNGs (same policy as `tools/gen_sprites.py`). Auto-backups
(`*.blend1`) are gitignored.
detail: Blender .blend files can embed Python (auto-run scripts, driver expressions). The render script itself loads no .blend (verified), so exposure is only collaborators opening committed .blend files with auto-run enabled.
recommended_fix: Add one README line: open committed .blend files with Auto Run Python Scripts disabled (the Blender default); review .blend additions like code at fold-in.
